title: प्रत्येक नोकरी अलर्ट WhatsApp + Telegram वर
description: BGSSL has announced 3 MIS Analyst vacancies at GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, under the Retail Sales department. The role involves managing data for client reporting, preparing daily, weekly and monthly dashboards, handling campaign and dialer data, automating reports and providing performance analysis to operations teams. Candidates should be Graduates with strong knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI. The closest matching BGSSL job description indicates a requirement of 2 years of Contact Centre experience, including 1 year as an MIS Executive. The last date to apply is 30 September 2026\.
